phase_prompt.label: The Dark Array
phase_prompt.summary: The full herd manifests as a sprawling, dark mass on the simulation floor. A study in texture, shadow, and the overwhelming weight of the multitude.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic close-up of a black bull's face, the camera lens capturing every pore and strand of dark, fiber-optic fur. The eye is a reflective sphere of black glass, mirroring a grid-lined horizon. The lighting is low-key, dramatic, carving the animal's powerful form out of the darkness. Behind it, the out-of-focus shapes of hundreds of other black cattle form a restless sea of shadow. The aesthetic is serious, grounded, and heavy, evoking a sense of ancient, programmed sorrow within a high-tech containment field.
